<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="r1x0LFFhiWbENmPkgIPy"> <mxGraphModel dx="2289" dy="1249" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor C as Citizen
 participant UI as Waste Management Portal
 participant AUTH as Authentication Service
 participant WM as Waste Management Service
 participant ML as Computer Vision / ML
 participant SCH as Scheduling Service
 actor OFF as Municipal Officer
 actor SUP as Supervisor
 participant GPS as GPS Tracking Service
 actor DR as Driver
 actor WK as Waste Worker
 participant NOTIF as Notification Service
 database DB as Waste Database

 C->>UI: Submit waste report
 UI->>AUTH: Validate session
 AUTH-->>UI: Authentication result
 UI->>WM: Create waste report
 WM->>ML: Classify waste image
 ML-->>WM: Category + confidence
 WM->>DB: Store report and bin status
 WM->>ML: Predict collection demand
 ML-->>WM: Priority prediction
 WM->>SCH: Generate collection schedule
 SCH->>OFF: Request schedule review
 OFF->>SUP: Request approval
 SUP-->>OFF: Approve schedule
 OFF->>SCH: Confirm schedule
 SCH->>WM: Assign vehicle and workers
 WM->>DR: Send route
 WM->>WK: Send assignment
 DR->>GPS: Start route / send location
 GPS-->>WM: Live GPS location
 DR->>WM: Collection started
 WK->>WM: Waste collected
 WM->>DB: Update collection status
 WM->>NOTIF: Trigger notification
 NOTIF-->>C: Collection completed
 C->>UI: Submit complaint if needed
 UI->>WM: Create complaint
 WM->>OFF: Assign complaint
 OFF->>WM: Resolve complaint
 WM->>DB: Record complaint and audit log",
 "config": null
